tools.name: validate_email
tools.description: Check an email address: syntax, MX/A records via DNS-over-HTTPS, disposable domain, role address, free provider, typo suggestion for major providers. No SMTP probing. Uses 1 check.

tools.name: validate_emails
tools.description: Check a list of up to 50 email addresses in one call, with the same checks as validate_email. Returns one result per address in the same order plus a summary of verdicts. tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description: Parse and validate a phone number: valid, possible, type, region, E.164 and national formats. Uses 1 check.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_email, validate_emails · Private data: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_email, validate_emails · Private data: validate_email · Public sink: validate_email, validate_emails

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
